name: SAP MM
certifications: SAP Certified Associate - SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, Sourcing and Procurement (C_TS452)
SAP Certified Associate - Implementation Consultant - SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, Sourcing and Procurement (C_S4CPR)

beginner.summary: For buyers, warehouse staff and new consultants with no SAP experience. Covers the logistics organisation, material and supplier master data, info records and source lists, purchase requisitions and orders, RFQs and outline agreements, goods receipts and movements, stock types, physical inventory, invoice verification, services, reorder-point planning and procurement reporting in S/4HANA.
prerequisites: Understands basic purchasing and stores work: orders, deliveries and invoices
Comfortable with business software and spreadsheets
Access to an SAP S/4HANA training system
outcomes: Maintain materials, suppliers, info records and source lists
Run procure to pay from requisition to invoice in S/4HANA
Post goods movements, count stock and read stock reports
Handle invoice blocks and GR/IR differences and report on procurement

intermediate.summary: For key users and junior consultants who can run procure to pay. Covers configuration of the logistics organisation, material and supplier master data, purchasing documents, pricing, approvals and output, source determination, subcontracting, consignment and stock transport orders, inventory management, valuation and account determination, batches, invoice verification, physical inventory, MRP and supplier evaluation in S/4HANA.

advanced.summary: For senior MM consultants, procurement solution architects and transformation leads. Covers procurement solution architecture, central procurement, SAP Ariba and SAP Business Network, guided buying and catalogues, embedded EWM, predictive and demand-driven planning, situation handling, Joule and AI, intercompany procurement, supplier risk and sustainability, migration and conversion, extensibility, integration, controls, archiving, testing, troubleshooting and procurement transformation.
prerequisites: Has configured SAP MM in at least one project
Knows pricing, account determination, special procurement and invoice verification configuration
Understands S/4HANA deployment options and integration basics
outcomes: Design procurement architectures across S/4HANA, central procurement and SAP Business Network
Lead planning, inventory, risk and AI improvements in procurement
Plan procurement migration, conversion, extensions and integration
Lead procurement transformation with controls, testing and roadmaps
